---
title: "Historical SAMHSA Treatment Facility Data"
description: "Address-level historical treatment facility listings reconstructed from SAMHSA directory PDFs."
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

This project reconstructs address-level treatment facility listings from 22 SAMHSA directories: 1998, 2000, 2001, and 2003-2021. It preserves both the directory year and the survey year represented by the directory.

<div class="data-release-status">
  <strong>Version 1 Preview</strong>
  <span>Quality assurance in progress</span>
  <span>22 directories</span>
</div>

These are historical records, not a current treatment locator. Counts, addresses, and service classifications may change as manual review continues. Historical phone numbers are included in the research files but may be stale.

<details class="data-details">
<summary>Limitations</summary>

Manual gold-sample review is incomplete. County geography is preliminary and includes assignment method and confidence. A missing characteristic means it was not asked or cannot be harmonized for that year, not that no facility offered it. Pre-2021 N-SSATS and post-2020 N-SUMHSS data are not directly trend-comparable.

</details>
